# Gender API

Gender API determines the gender of a first name, email address, or username.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gender-api/.

## Actions

- **Gender From First Name** (read-only): Determine the gender of a first name.
- **Get Country of Origin** (read-only): Retrieve a name's likely countries of origin.
- **Get Gender API Statistics** (read-only): Retrieve account statistics from Gender-API, including remaining credits and usage details.
- **Query Gender by Email Address** (read-only): Determine gender from an email address.
- **Query Gender by Full Name** (read-only): Determine gender by splitting a full name.
